title: Order total is $0.01 too high
clean: A cart with 1 x Mug The adventure begins ($11.90) and Standard shipping: products $11.90 + shipping $5.00 + tax $0.95 = total $17.85.
with_bug: Same cart: products, shipping and tax unchanged, but the total is $17.86. Cart, checkout and the placed order all show the wrong total.
mechanism: Override classes/Cart.php: getOrderTotal() adds $0.01 to the tax-inclusive grand total (type BOTH). Deliberately subtle.
